environment.description: IoT gateway running on EC2 instance (t3.medium) in us-east-1, exposed via NLB on port 8443. PyJWT 1.7.1 installed. RSA public key is 2048-bit, stored at /etc/iot-gateway/public_key.pem. HMAC secret rotated every 60 seconds by a sidecar cron job writing to /etc/iot-gateway/hmac_secret.key. No TLS termination at NLB level (passthrough). Device registry populated from DynamoDB on startup.

config.key_rotation: HMAC secret rotated every 60s by cron sidecar
